set.seo.description: Hamish Burke is a developer in Wellington, New Zealand, who builds systems and then tests what happens when they fail.

set.heading: Web developer at Alphero, in Wellington.
set.intro: I’m Hamish. I build software, and most of what’s on this site started with me wanting to find out how something worked, then building it on my own time. A lot of it comes back to the same two questions, who is allowed to reach a system, and what it does when part of it goes away.

largeCopy.__blockText: I work at Alphero as a web developer. Mostly that means building other people’s products, from the front end down through the services behind it. The projects here are things I’ve built outside that job, and they look scattered, though most of them come back to the same thing, a system somebody else can reach, and what it does when a part of it fails.

set.seo.description: Hamish Burke is a web developer at Alphero in Wellington, New Zealand, with a master’s in computer science from Victoria University of Wellington.
